description: Build chat intent eval cases. Each case is one chat request and the outcome the build editor should plan for it: question (answered, nothing changes), change (applied; kind = what it should touch) or refused (a policy refusal). Requests are phrased so they apply to any generated build; use_case says which kind of use case the phrasing comes from. Run live with scripts/eval_chat_intents.py.
